outcome: Presence of myometrial fibers in the decidua basalis or parietalis
Presence of myometrial fibers in direct contact with the Rohr fibrinoid or chorionic villi
Diffuse postuterine pattern of chronic hypoxic placental injury
Clusters of avascular or mineralized chorionic villi
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery (n=830) and women who had a vaginal delivery (n=907)
finding: The study found no statistically significant difference in the occurrence of mild forms of placenta creta between placentas delivered by cesarean section for non-anatomical indications and those from vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Mild forms of placenta creta (MPC) were not statistically more common in placentas delivered by cesarean section for non-anatomical indications compared to vaginal deliveries.
